text:
taylor_docs: Just opened a compact PR to the Optimize toolkit migration page. Goals: add a tiny migrate checklist, clarify quant_profile aliases (no runtime break), and provide two micro SDK snippets for dialog vs batch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3801 preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration

ci-bot: PR #3801 opened by taylor_docs  labels: docs,optkit,quick

ori_eng: skimmed. Confirming: runtime defaults unchanged, aliases only in docs, correct?

taylor_docs: correct. top-of-page callout "No runtime behavior changes; aliases are documentation-only." included. Also added a short rename helper for teams who want to opt-in: `find . -name '*.yml' -exec sed -i 's/quant_profile:\s*q8_0/q8_0_compat/g' {} +`

hema_opt: please add a short heuristic for KV prefetch: it improves throughput for long sequences but can increase first-token latency for streaming flows. recommend disabling for short-turn dialog (seq < 48).

ben_pm: product tiny ask: step that links to Console should point at /console/telemetry and call out that rollouts respect aliases.

taylor_docs: done. added two labeled snippets under "Quick snippets":
```python
# dialog (low-latency)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_compat')
print(c.generate('User: Hi\nBot:'))
```
```python
# batch (throughput)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=64, prefetch_kv=True, quant_profile='q8_compat')
print(c.batch_generate(['Summarize:...']*32))
```

ori_eng: left a tiny nit about wording in the alias table header. also request to paste microbench numbers for reviewers.

taylor_docs: pasted quick smoke numbers: "[smoke] dialog seq=16 p50=33ms toks/s=148" and "[smoke] batch seq=256 p50=120ms toks/s=512". CI link-check shows one Console link; fixed and rebased.

ci-bot: CI: docs-lint PASS, link-check PASS

hema_opt: LGTM from opt. concise and actionable. will monitor support threads after merge.

ben_pm: LGTM from product once release-note one-liner added.

ori_eng: LGTM from eng after tiny header wording edit.

ci-bot: merged by taylor_docs  deployment: staging updated 

taylor_docs: merged. I'll add a 1-line release note and ping #support to watch for any migration questions in the next 48h. :tada:
